subject: cork courier robot
requested_medium: cork, glazed clay, and wire miniature
art_direction: 软木方圆机器人背一只小布袋，两根弯线天线、陶瓷面片，姿态轻快。
composition: one original central subject with a clear silhouette and circular-crop safe focal point
creative_direction: Make a small courier robot with a rounded cork torso, ceramic face plate, and two bent wire antennae. A close-fitting cloth satchel hangs across its body, with no writing on the flap. Pose it with one foot slightly raised and one hand holding the strap, suggesting brisk ordinary movement. Use warm cork pores, celadon glaze, and slate-blue fabric, adding one terracotta button. Keep the face friendly and understated. Place it on a pale warm field under soft side light, avoiding glossy plastic, visible electronics, or a cluttered delivery scene. Square 1024x1024. Keep the complete central silhouette within a circular crop, occupying about 70% of the canvas. Original design; no lettering, logos, or watermark.
style_inspiration: Entirely original text-only concept, no IP characters, copied artwork, celebrity likeness or named artist imitation.
